systems.summary: A GURPS 4th Edition game system implementing the Basic Set rules for Foundry VTT v14.

modules.summary: Adventure clocks for Pathfinder 2e: progress, countdowns, threats, factions, corruption, alarms, projects and weather fronts.
A GM-managed custom world calendar with campaign notes and an expandable timeline of Ages and events.
A Pathfinder 2e GM workspace for party profiles, XP budgets, creature browsing and balanced encounter generation.
A collaborative pinboard where players pin clues and string them together to work cases as a party.
Animated 3D dice for every roll in hand-designed Sargas, Oracle, Spiral Set and Classic styles.
Plays and automates JB2A animations directly, without Sequencer or Automated Animations.
A spellbook creator and slot-fill tool for the Pathfinder Second Edition system.
Shares one compendium library between two Pathfinder 2e worlds on the same Foundry installation.
Shared, always-visible progress and threshold tracks for any game system (Foundry v14).
The Foundry v13 build of Victory Counter: shared progress and threshold tracks for any game system.
GURPS books' text and statistics overlaid onto the GWorld system's compendia, for one table whose members own the books.
